timeline.event: Used during an attack on an American garrison in which 45 soldiers were killed; taken to the US
Housed at F.E. Warren Air Force Base, Wyoming
Become property of the US Air Force Museum System
Officially presented to the Philippine government at F.E. Warren AFB

tiers.everyday: The Bells of Balangiga were church bells taken from the Philippines by US troops in 1901. The United States gave them back in 2018.
tiers.student: The US Air Force records that the bells were used in a 1901 attack in which 45 US soldiers were killed, were kept at F.E. Warren AFB from 1904, joined the Air Force museum system in 1992 and were presented to the Philippines on 14 November 2018. Number of bells and present place [UNKNOWN] from official pages we could open.
